g.text: TCA9555 16-bit I/O expander (I2C0 0x20): cliffs XSHUT, bumpers, IMU, status

g.desc: TCA9555 16-bit I/O expander (I2C0 0x20): cliffs XSHUT, bumpers, IMU, status

g.text: INT is open-drain to IO41. Bumpers are read on the INT edge (<1 ms).

g.desc: INT is open-drain to IO41. Bumpers are read on the INT edge (<1 ms).

g.text: Pi link: UART0 (also the ROM bootloader port) + Pi-controlled reset/boot for esptool

g.desc: Pi link: UART0 (also the ROM bootloader port) + Pi-controlled reset/boot for esptool

g.text: All 31 free GPIOs used. Slow I/O goes through the TCA9555. ADC1 (IO4-7) reads the four IPROPI currents.

g.desc: All 31 free GPIOs used. Slow I/O goes through the TCA9555. ADC1 (IO4-7) reads the four IPROPI currents.

g.text: Sink only: 5.1k Rd on CC1/CC2. VBUS feeds the 3.3 V LDO through a Schottky, so the ESP32 flashes with the battery off.

g.desc: Sink only: 5.1k Rd on CC1/CC2. VBUS feeds the 3.3 V LDO through a Schottky, so the ESP32 flashes with the battery off.

g.text: 1k series resistors stop back-powering when only one side is on.

g.desc: 1k series resistors stop back-powering when only one side is on.
